title: Policy
description: Runtime behavioural policy governing a lease. Source of truth: DSL Best Practices Chapter 11.03 (Policy Object) and Chapter 12.06 (Offline and Grace Behavior).

renewBeforeSeconds.description: Seconds before expiry at which renewal should begin.

offlineGraceSeconds.description: Bounded seconds operation may continue after expiry without a successful renewal (Chapter 12.06).

onGraceExhausted.description: Controlled exhaustion action. Controlled vocabulary per Chapter 12.06.

heartbeatSeconds.description: Expected runtime/reporting heartbeat interval, if used.

renewBackoff.description: Bounded retry behaviour for renewal attempts.

alertThresholds.description: Seconds-remaining thresholds at which operator alerts should fire.

revocationEndpoint.description: Optional push endpoint (e.g. WebSocket URL) for revocation/policy updates.

tenantOverridesAllowed.description: Whether tenant override of selected policy settings is permitted.

$comment: Aligned on both sides: the implementation seed data already uses these field names.
